title: Sourcing Plugin Extensions De-Sandwich
description: De-sandwich 🪵️sourcing's 3 extension crates (beams/slabs/windows) per Rule B (extensions stay separate installable/loadable units, de-sandwiched in place, published names frozen). Scope: ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/🧩️extensions/** only (main sourcing plugin crate at 📦️packages/🦀️rust already migrated by a prior ticket - SOURCING-PLUGIN-MIGRATION-TO-CRATE-AND-TAXONOMY-CONSOLIDATION and SOURCING-SHAPE-V2-TREE-PURITY-RETROFIT - do not touch it, only its dependents' path deps if needed). Each of 🧩️extensions/🪵️beams, 🧩️extensions/🧱️slabs, 🧩️extensions/🪟️windows currently has Cargo.toml + 📦️lib.rs directly under ⚡️implementations/🦀️rust. Move each to 🧩️extensions/<name>/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ (Shape V2 shaped: entry file 📦️lib.rs same-dir as manifest), published crate names (semio-s-plugin-sourcing-beams/slabs/windows) and component package ids (semio:sourcing-module-beams/slabs/windows) frozen exactly. Each already depends on the main sourcing crate via a path dep (sourcing_curate = { path = "...", package = "semio-s-plugin-sourcing" }) pointing at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/📦️packages/🦀️rust - verify whether the relative path depth needs adjusting given each extension's own directory got one level deeper-equivalent (⚡️implementations replaced by 📦️packages, same depth expected, but confirm). Update root Cargo.toml member lines via registrar handoff only - do not edit directly. Verify each of the 3 new crates independently with cargo check/clippy/test via isolated temp workspace overlay (root workspace may be blocked by a pre-existing norm dangling-manifest issue per the SOURCING-SHAPE-V2 ticket's own finding - use the overlay approach documented in TEMPLATE.md §3). Delete old ⚡️implementations sandwiches only once each new crate is green.
summary: Confirmed and closed Rule B de-sandwich for all three 🪵️sourcing extensions (🪵️beams, 🧱️slabs, 🪟️windows): each crate at `<ext>/📦️packages/🦀️rust/{Cargo.toml,📦️lib.rs}`, `[lib] path = "📦️lib.rs"`, `[package.metadata.semio] role = "extension"`, frozen `semio-s-plugin-sourcing-*` names and `semio:sourcing-module-*` component ids, `sourcing_curate` path dep unchanged in depth (seven `../` to repo root then into main sourcing package). Added/confirmed nx `📋️project.json` + `📜️script.ts` on all three. Deleted legacy `⚡️implementations` sandwiches (none remain under `🧩️extensions/**`). Root `Cargo.toml` member lines already at new paths — see `📋️registrar-handoff.md` (no registrar action on main). Verification: ticket-folder overlays `verify-beams/slabs/windows` run `cargo check` but fail in transitive `semio-framework-ui-wgpu` (unrelated concurrent UI-family edit); root `cargo check -p semio-s-plugin-sourcing-{beams,slabs,windows}` blocked by unrelated workspace/math consolidation — not fixable in this ticket's scope. 🏭️process plugin has no `⚡️implementations` residue.
